learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Smart Pointers and Interior Mutability.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.

overview_visual.alt_text: Roadmap for module 15, Smart Pointers and Interior Mutability.
overview_visual.caption: Representative milestones for module 15; all lessons remain listed in sequence.

notes: Choose smart pointers and interior-mutability tools that match ownership requirements. Box provides single ownership of heap data, Rc shares ownership in one thread, Arc shares ownership across threads, and interior mutability changes when borrowing is checked.
